findings.message: Resolved in fix round 1: the checkpoint policy now says review cadence does not create extra permission requirements, pauses apply only when explicitly selected, the user's latest authorization overrides defaults, and high-risk work inside approved scope receives gates/review/verification without a new user permission step.

summary: Independent re-review verified the scale policy correction against the user's standing scoped Git/PR/merge authorization. The prior major finding is resolved and both fresh exact-snapshot gates passed.
